name: The Wrath of Rath'mael

angles.text: As Forsaken, you live in the Undercity beneath the ruined capital. Scourge forces in the courtyards and graveyards above threaten your doorstep.
As a member of the Horde, you have a foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms. Securing Lordaeron's surrounding lands helps preserve it against the relentless undead.

faq.answer: Rath'mael is a Scourge necromancer who has risen among the undead in the Ruins of Lordaeron. His dark sorcery conjures an unholy fog that conceals Scourge movements in the streets and graveyard near Lordamere Overlook.

aliases: what is the fog in lordaeron
why is there fog in ruins of lordaeron
faq.answer: The unholy fog over the ruined capital's streets and graveyard is conjured by Rath'mael. It conceals lingering Scourge forces from Forsaken patrols.
faq.q: What is the unholy fog in the Ruins of Lordaeron?

faq.answer: Deathguard Kristof, a Forsaken soldier, offers the call from Brill in Tirisfal Glades. He watches the approaches to the Capital City ruins and calls for Rath'mael's death before the Scourge threat grows too great.
Rath'mael operates in the Ruins of Lordaeron, around its streets and graveyard and near Lordamere Overlook above the lake.
The Forsaken fear the Scourge gathering forces and hiding their movements above the Undercity. Rath'mael's fog threatens Forsaken defenses and travelers throughout Tirisfal.
faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want Rath'mael destroyed?

aliases: does killing rathmael end the scourge
will scourge be gone after rathmael
faq.answer: No. The Scourge will replace fallen lieutenants with another dark spellcaster. Rath'mael's death slows their immediate advance, thins their numbers, and lifts the fog for a time.
faq.q: Does Rath'mael's death permanently secure the ruins?

sections.body: Scout reports from Lordamere Overlook tell of a sinister presence in the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog now covers the ruined streets and nearby graveyard, hiding lingering Scourge forces. Rath'mael cast the shroud. His spells conceal the undead above the heart of Forsaken territory.
sections.title: A Shroud Over the Ruins

sections.body: Deathguard Kristof in Brill sends you to rally your allies and strike Rath'mael down. The Forsaken cannot let this menace take root unchecked. The Scourge may replace him, but his fall will disrupt their coordination, disperse the fog, and give Tirisfal Glades room to breathe.
sections.title: The Defense of Tirisfal

summary: In the Ruins of Lordaeron, a fog hides Scourge movements above the Undercity. Rath'mael, a Scourge necromancer, has shrouded the ruined streets and graveyard. Deathguard Kristof in Brill calls for you to strike him down.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Wrath of Rath'mael
